rows.note: Use 捐款 as the all-purpose noun for a monetary donation or contribution.

example.english: I made a donation to this event.
example.traditional: 我捐咗一筆捐款俾今次活動。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gyun1 zo2 jat1 bat1 gyun1 fun2 bei2 gam1 ci3 wut6 dung6

rows.note: Use 善款 specifically for money donated to a charitable or public-welfare cause.

example.english: This donation will be used to help families in need.
example.traditional: 呢筆善款會用嚟幫助有需要嘅家庭。
example.jyutping: ni1 bat1 sin6 fun2 wui5 jung6 lei4 bong1 zo6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 gaa1 ting4
